title: 법정 방청 및 촬영 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02714:20170202:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 법정 방청 및 촬영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on Debtor Rehabilitation and Bankruptcy) <Supreme Court Rule No. 2714, February 2, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on March 1, 2017.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Rules)
(1) through (5) Omitted.

(6) The Rules on Court Attendance, Photography, etc. shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 6 (3) 1, "president of the district court (including the president of a Family Court or Administrative Court)" shall be replaced with "president of the district court (including the president of a Family Court, Administrative Court or Rehabilitation Court)".

(7) through (15) Omitted.
